Graphical Perception: Theory, Experimentation, and Application to the Development of Graphical Methods
contribution: Empirical foundation for ranking graphical encodings by perceptual accuracy.

title: The Eyes Have It: A Task by Data Type Taxonomy for Information Visualizations
contribution: Introduced the visual information-seeking mantra: overview first, zoom and filter, then details-on-demand.

title: Polaris: A System for Query, Analysis and Visualization of Multi-dimensional Relational Databases
contribution: Combined visual specification with database queries for rapid exploration of multidimensional data; an important precursor to Tableau.

title: Show Me: Automatic Presentation for Visual Analysis
contribution: Integrated automatic chart presentation into Tableau and formalized practical defaults for visual analysis.

title: Animated Transitions in Statistical Data Graphics
contribution: Empirically studied when animated transitions improve perception across changes in statistical graphics.

title: Rainbow Color Map (Still) Considered Harmful
contribution: Explained perceptual problems with rainbow color maps and argued for more appropriate color encodings.

title: Protovis: A Graphical Toolkit for Visualization
contribution: Introduced a declarative mark-based toolkit that helped shape later web visualization systems including D3.

title: A Nested Model for Visualization Design and Validation
contribution: Proposed a four-level model linking domain problems, data/task abstraction, visual encoding/interaction, and algorithms.

title: A Tour through the Visualization Zoo
contribution: Surveyed a broad range of useful visualization techniques and their application contexts.

title: Crowdsourcing Graphical Perception: Using Mechanical Turk to Assess Visualization Design
contribution: Validated crowdsourcing for graphical-perception studies and extended evidence about visual encoding effectiveness.

title: A Layered Grammar of Graphics
contribution: Formalized the layered grammar underlying ggplot2 and a compositional way to reason about statistical graphics.

title: D3: Data-Driven Documents
contribution: Introduced a web-native approach that binds data directly to DOM elements for expressive interactive visualization.

title: What Makes a Visualization Memorable?
contribution: Large-scale empirical study of factors associated with visualization memorability.

title: The Effects of Interactive Latency on Exploratory Visual Analysis
contribution: Showed that interaction latency can reduce exploration activity, dataset coverage, observations, and hypothesis generation.

title: How Deceptive Are Deceptive Visualizations?
contribution: Empirically examined common visual distortion techniques and when they lead viewers to incorrect interpretations.

title: Voyager: Exploratory Analysis via Faceted Browsing of Visualization Recommendations
contribution: Combined automatic visualization recommendation with faceted browsing to support open-ended data exploration.

title: Vega-Lite: A Grammar of Interactive Graphics
contribution: Introduced a concise high-level grammar for declarative interactive visualization.

title: Formalizing Visualization Design Knowledge as Constraints: Actionable and Extensible Models in Draco
contribution: Formalized visualization design knowledge as constraints for automated recommendation and design validation.
